About the event

⛳✨ THE WAIT IS OVER – BOOKINGS ARE NOW OPEN! ✨⛳

The most anticipated ladies golf event of the year is officially back...

📅 25th June 2027




📍 Belton Woods Championship Course

The Ladies Tee Time returns for another unforgettable day of golf, fun, fashion, networking, entertainment and memories that will last long after the final putt drops.

For just £95 per person, your day includes:




🥐 Breakfast / Tea and Coffees




🍽️ Sit Down One-course lunch




⛳ 18 holes on the stunning Championship Course




🎧 DJ on the course - Playing your team entrance music, shouting out your team name and players! Bringing the energy to tee off! 




🍸 Bars - Tequila and Rum! Giving you the courage to take on the course! 




⛳  Golf Brands - Fashion Shows / Pop Up shops for you to try on the latest threads! 




🏆 Competitions and loads of  up for prizes grabs!




✨ Plus plenty more surprises throughout the day

This isn't just a golf day. It's the most sought-after tee time in the ladies golf calendar.

Want to make a weekend of it?

🏨 Exclusive accommodation rates:




• Night Before: £139 Single Occupancy B&B | £149 Shared Occupancy B&B




• Night Of: £139 Single Occupancy B&B | £149 Shared Occupancy B&B




💆‍♀️ Enjoy 20% off spa packages when booking a room either the night before or the night of the event.

⛳ Plus, guests staying overnight can take advantage of shoulder day green fees from just £35 per person (subject to availability), giving you the perfect excuse for even more golf.




Last year's event sold quickly, and demand for 2027 is already building.




📩 Complete the booking form today to secure your place and avoid disappointment.




Gather your golfing friends, book your spot, and get ready for the ladies golf event everyone will be talking about.
